work_reference_definition: Lower median of the continuous-time distribution of actual TCP Z, linearly interpolated only on jointly observed in-ROI ON support of the first successfully completed ordered pass; each piece weighted by end_s-start_s. Constants are point masses; nonconstant pieces are uniform in Z. Frozen causally at first REQUIRED_PASS_OBSERVED.
